messages:
maya: Hey, hitting a weird pattern in the sample app during onboarding. When we page through results with the JS SDK and a client-side concurrency limiter, token refresh + retry logic causes duplicate page requests and a short retry storm. Seeing double billing for the same page and intermittent 429s. Anyone seen this?
kevin: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro? sounds like single-flight refresh missing + our retry/backoff interacts with pagination concurrency.
maya: repro gist:
```
// naive paging
const pages = [1,2,3,4]
await Promise.all(pages.map(p => client.list({page:p})))
// client has auth middleware that does refresh when 401 -> replays original request
// plus our retry middleware retries idempotently
```
If two requests get 401 at same time, both call refresh separately, then both replay, and the paginator has no de-dup so you get overlapping fetches for same page.
kevin: that explains double billing. JS SDK should have a single-flight token refresh (like Python has) + a per-request unique idempotency key for list pages.
tom: also the retry/backoff increments on 5xx/429 and doesn't check "is this request already completed"; in a highly concurrent client it will replay paginated offsets. We should add an in-flight-request cache keyed by method+params+auth-version to prevent duplicate inflight calls.
alice: agreed. low-effort mitigation: reduce default client-side concurrency in quickstarts from 10 -> 3 and call out token refresh caveat in onboarding guide.
maya: lowered concurrency helps but still flakes on slow refresh (network). I'd like a fix in SDK where refresh is deduped and list() has optional "serializePages:true" flag for example apps.
kevin: creating an issue and tentative plan:
- add single-flight refresh to JS auth middleware (mirror Python)
- add optional per-client in-flight cache with weak TTL to dedupe identical in-flight calls
- add e2e test in sample-apps that simulates expired token + concurrent pages
- docs note for onboarding + quickstart code samples
I'll open a PR by EOD.
maya: thanks! also noticed our retry timer uses jitter that is too small; when many clients jitter overlaps -> burst. can we widen jitter window?
tom: yep widen and randomize better. also add a max-retries cap per pagination session to avoid infinite loops.
sdk-bot: deploy-checklist: create changelog entry, add unit + e2e tests, and update upgrade notes for breaking change in token middleware.
devex-bot: FYI tagging @alice to update quickstart and onboarding doc snips once PR merges.
alice: will update docs and add a short note about "why your sample app might double-fetch when using high concurrency".
maya: one last ask — can we add an opt-in pagination helper that serializes page fetches under the hood? novice devs keep doing Promise.all for pages.
kevin: good idea. i'll prototype a helper `client.paginateSerially()` with backpressure+resume token support.
maya: perfect. leaving logs and a small flamegraph in the issue. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: np, marking this as blocker for the sample-app release until tests land.
